summary: Completed immutable versioned book/borrower CRUD, confirmed deletion of unused records, archive/restore, literal search and immediate save-before-memory commits.

Added retained loan receipts with accepted title/name snapshots, atomic checkout/return, current-loan consistency, date and reference validation, history-protected deletion and durable allocation watermarks.

Replaced independent file writes with one bounded strict snapshot, cooperative cross-process baseline protection and atomic replacement; legacy-pair conversion preserves both original files unchanged.

Added 53 passing Java/CLI/process checks, compilation after consistent source formatting, preserved historical notes and nine detailed learning documents connecting aggregate consistency to future CRUD HTTP and SQL design.

checks.environment: JDK 17; Python 3.13; disposable files; independent JVM concurrency
checks.command: python scripts/verify.py (44 Java tests, 9 CLI/process checks); separate UTF-8 compilation after Java formatting

limits: The project remains a Java CLI without HTTP/browser UI, authentication, ownership policy, external notifications, fines, renewals or SQL deployment.
File locking is cooperative and atomic replacement depends on filesystem support; no power-loss, directory-flush, network-filesystem or multi-machine certification.
Rejected terminal input is not retained as a draft or automatically merged; reload and deliberate re-entry are required. Snapshots are bounded to 10 MiB and 10,000 records per collection.
Legacy current loans gain receipts using names available at import; previously discarded returns cannot be reconstructed. ISBN and email checks do not provide external verification.
